description: This file declares the SerializeCommandVisitor class, which implements the ISerializeCommandVisitor interface for serializing different command objects related to calculator expressions, using Windows Storage Streams DataWriter.

classes.name: SerializeCommandVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that serializes various command objects into a data stream.

methods.name: SerializeCommandVisitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the visitor with a DataWriter for serialization.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Overloaded methods to visit and serialize specific command types: COpndCommand, CUnaryCommand, CBinaryCommand, CParentheses.
